IN PHOTOS | Workers conduct repair works inside the sunog apog pumping station in Tondo, Manila on Sunday (August 17). 

Manila Mayor Isko Moreno blamed defective pumping stations for the flooding experienced in his city during the onslaught of the southwest monsoon. 

Senator Marcoleta called on the public to help the Senate investigate by filing complaints against those responsible for substandard or anomalous projects in their jurisdictions. 

📷 Norman Cruz

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
